# The Map Room's color scales (common/journal_entries/te_journal_maps.txt): each map's factor, 0-1. Nearly every
# map is fitted to the world as it stands: its curve keeps its shape on the span from the world's low to its
# high (te_jmap_<map>_lo / _hi, stored by te_journal_map_ranges_generated.txt's effects on each pick and each
# month; the fixed curve's ends before the first). Change a shape or a row in the generator and re-run it;
# test_journal_map_scales.py fails when this file is stale. A value reading a figure runs with a STATE as root,
# once per state as the map paints; _lo, _hi and their kin read only globals, from any scope.

}

	multiply = 1.6
}

		limit = { turmoil < te_jmap_turmoil_k1 }

	}
	min = 0
	max = 1

	value = te_jmap_natural_span_up

	add = te_jmap_natural_a
}

	value = te_jmap_natural_span_up

	value = te_jmap_natural_span_up
	multiply = 6
}

		limit = { has_variable = te_dg_cbr has_variable = te_dg_cdr }

			limit = { te_demog_natural_change < 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { te_demog_natural_change > te_jmap_natural_l_k1 }
				value = te_demog_natural_change subtract = te_jmap_natural_b divide = te_jmap_natural_l_d0 add = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = te_demog_natural_change subtract = te_jmap_natural_l_k1 divide = te_jmap_natural_l_d1 add = 0.14706
			}
			max = 0.5
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { te_demog_natural_change < te_jmap_natural_u_k1 }
				value = te_demog_natural_change subtract = te_jmap_natural_a divide = te_jmap_natural_u_d0 add = 0.5
			}
			else = {
				value = te_demog_natural_change subtract = te_jmap_natural_u_k1 divide = te_jmap_natural_u_d1 add = 0.94444
			}
			min = 0.5
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1

			}

	max = 1

# GDP per capita, a year's GDP per person in pounds: the same share of the color for each doubling from the world's low to its high (a rich country about 1 in 1836, 8 in 1917, 60 today).
# A doubling at a time, fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0.25 to 256.
te_jmap_gdppc_input = {
	value = gdp_per_capita
}
te_jmap_gdppc_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_gdppc_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_gdppc_lo = {
	value = 0.25
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gdppc_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_gdppc_lo
	}
	min = 0.01
}
te_jmap_gdppc_hi = {
	value = 256
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_gdppc_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_gdppc_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_gdppc_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_gdppc_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_gdppc_lo
	multiply = 4
}
te_jmap_gdppc_ratio = {
	value = gdp_per_capita
	divide = te_jmap_gdppc_lo
}
te_jmap_gdppc_log = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
}
te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio = {
	value = te_jmap_gdppc_hi
	divide = te_jmap_gdppc_lo
}
te_jmap_gdppc_log_span = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 2 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio subtract = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 4 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 8 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 4 add = 1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 16 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 8 add = 2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 32 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 16 add = 3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 64 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 32 add = 4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 128 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 64 add = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 256 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 128 add = 6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 512 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 256 add = 7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 1024 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 512 add = 8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 2048 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 1024 add = 9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 4096 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 2048 add = 10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 8192 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 4096 add = 11
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 16384 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 8192 add = 12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 32768 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 16384 add = 13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 65536 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 32768 add = 14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 131072 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 65536 add = 15
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 262144 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 131072 add = 16
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 524288 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 262144 add = 17
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio < 1048576 }
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 524288 add = 18
	}
	else = {
		value = te_jmap_gdppc_span_ratio divide = 1048576 add = 19
	}
	min = 1
}
te_jmap_gdppc_factor = {
	value = te_jmap_gdppc_log
	divide = te_jmap_gdppc_log_span
	min = 0
	max = 1
}

# Migration Crowding's cut to migration attraction, 0-1 and past it, as the state panel's tile shows it: two-thirds of the color by 31% of the world's range.
# Fitted to the world; before the first measure, 0 to 1.45.
te_jmap_crowding_input = {
	value = migration_crowding_pull_pct
}
te_jmap_crowding_input_neg = {
	value = te_jmap_crowding_input
	multiply = -1
}
te_jmap_crowding_lo = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_crowding_lo }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_crowding_lo
	}
}
te_jmap_crowding_hi = {
	value = 1.45
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = te_jmap_rng_crowding_hi }
		value = global_var:te_jmap_rng_crowding_hi
	}
	min = te_jmap_crowding_hi_floor
}
te_jmap_crowding_hi_floor = {
	value = te_jmap_crowding_lo
	add = 0.1
}
te_jmap_crowding_span = {
	value = te_jmap_crowding_hi
	subtract = te_jmap_crowding_lo
}
te_jmap_crowding_k1 = {
	value = te_jmap_crowding_span
	multiply = 0.31034
	add = te_jmap_crowding_lo
}
te_jmap_crowding_d0 = {
	value = te_jmap_crowding_span
	multiply = 0.48276
}
te_jmap_crowding_d1 = {
	value = te_jmap_crowding_span
	multiply = 1.93103
}
te_jmap_crowding_factor = {
	if = {
		limit = { migration_crowding_pull_pct < te_jmap_crowding_k1 }
		value = migration_crowding_pull_pct subtract = te_jmap_crowding_lo divide = te_jmap_crowding_d0
	}
	else = {
		value = migration_crowding_pull_pct subtract = te_jmap_crowding_k1 divide = te_jmap_crowding_d1 add = 0.64286
	}
	min = 0
	max = 1
}
